notes: Item 19 discloses data for 15 company-owned stores (split into Top/Mid/Low tiers of 5 each) and 13 franchised stores. Company-owned data covers full calendar year 2025. Franchised store table covers January 1 to December 21, 2025 — the end date may be a typo for December 31, 2025 (OCR or drafting error noted). Washer/Dryer operational metrics (turns per day, price per turn) were not extracted as separate records as they are operational rather than financial performance metrics, but EBITDA, revenue, and key expense line items were captured. The three tiers are performance-anchored by revenue range, not tenure-based. No interest, taxes, depreciation, or amortization are included in expense or EBITDA figures per Note 12.
